offers.title: Diwali & Chhath home makeover
offers.text: Special prices on interior emulsions and distempers for your festive painting. Bring your room size – we'll work out the exact quantity.

offers.title: Free colour consultation
offers.text: Share a photo of your room or house on WhatsApp and we'll shortlist shades, finishes and the right primer for your walls.

offers.title: Painter & contractor pricing
offers.text: Better rates for painters, contractors and bulk orders of paint, putty, primer and Astral pipes. Ask us for a quote.

offers.title: Putty + primer + paint combo
offers.text: Buy the complete wall system together – wall putty, primer and emulsion – and save on the full package.

reviews.text: Excellent paint and sanitary shop with a wide range of quality paints (Berger, Asian and Birla Opus) and accessories. Friendly staff, reasonable price and great service. Highly recommended.

This is a very good home paint shop. The paint quality is good and the variety of colours is quite good. The shopkeeper is friendly and gives accurate advice. The prices are also reasonable. I would recommend this shop for home painting.
